description: Source code for ProjectClassLoader, a custom class loader used in Android UI preview within IntelliJ IDEA/Android Studio. It manages class loading from modules, dependencies, and external libraries, with special handling for Android resource classes.

classes.name: ProjectClassLoader
classes.description: Custom class loader for Android UI preview, handling class loading from modules, dependencies, and resources.

methods.name: findClass
methods.description: Attempts to find and define a class by name, with special handling for Android resource classes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ProjectClassLoader based on Android target and module.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a class by name, searching module dependencies and JARs.

methods.name: loadClassFromModuleOrDependency
methods.description: Recursively searches for a class in a module and its dependencies.

methods.name: loadClassFromModule
methods.description: Loads a class from a specific module, considering Gradle project structure.

methods.name: getExternalJars
methods.description: Retrieves URLs of external JAR libraries associated with the module.
